Dataset notices — 2026-10-16

UnlockMyLoot / 108 seconds and attributed contributors (Влад, nepetacataria).
Source: https://github.com/1h8s/unlockmyloot/tree/eee0bf50ebcb7fffd2b47954fd76bb015854e365
License: AGPL-3.0. Original published observations, independently decoded and normalized.
Source constants accompany the data in vendor/UnlockMyLoot-data-source.txt.
No application code was copied. Skill models are independently inferred by exhaustive
connection-removal checks against published routes; steps are independently recalculated.
Corresponding editable derived data, reconstruction tool and verification tests:
https://github.com/Daos711/site/tree/main/src/lib/gothic-locks
https://github.com/Daos711/site/tree/main/scripts
The AGPL terms continue to apply to the adapted UnlockMyLoot data.

derive skill models and calculate sequences independently. Full MIT notice follows.

Steam Nanomaks/Gra Airo and Lorthiz: references and independent comparison only;
their compiled solution arrays, prose and screenshots are not redistributed.
Game-file dumps from G1LockPickHelper and GothicSolve-derived arrays are not bundled.

Fisk reconstruction — independently generated mathematical models and BFS routes.
Generated numeric results: CC0-1.0, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
No license to any external guide or game-file dump is claimed. External sources are
linked as evidence of initial positions and reported physical movement observations.
Every coefficient was independently enumerated; all feasible models were retained.
A route is admitted only when every atomic press is valid in every retained model.
The assumptions of direct signed links and sequential removal of 0/1/2 connections
are explicit mathematical assumptions, not a claim of independent PS5 play-testing.
Reconstruction tool: https://github.com/Daos711/site/tree/main/scripts


Vladislav Durnev / drvladis — GothicRemakeLockOpener (MIT), copyright 2026.
https://github.com/drvladis/GothicRemakeLockOpener/tree/d086b57e7b2a024f3f7344c6dad28248194360fa
Licensed observation file: LocksCombinationsGothic1Remake.txt. Its original text and
complete MIT notice accompany this release. No exception for this file was found
in the license or source history. The original labels are cross-checked against
independent location descriptions before attaching observations to catalog IDs.
Changes: normalized atomic movements and bottom-first numbering; independently
enumerated directed coefficients, skill-specific alternatives, and safe BFS routes.
Mathematical inference is not a claim of independent in-game verification.
For large ambiguous model families, valid witness graphs cover every feasible
output column; checking all witnesses proves the route safe for every compatible
model. The public reconstruction tool and synthetic tests explain this proof.

Loot facts — independently curated 2026-10-16.
Direct article links and credited authors are attached to each loot record.
SpecialGamesClub / Евгений Баранов: the article/footer permits partial copying
with a direct link and prohibits full copying. We retain short normalized item
facts, not article prose, screenshots or the complete guide collection.
https://specialgamesclub.ru/
Land of Games: authors credited per article (lyubov, Droommar, Zorthrus).
The same sections 7.7–7.8 personal/noncommercial and attribution conditions above
apply to these selected facts; direct credits use no smaller type than item lists.
UnlockMyLoot, GameSlayer, GameFAQs, Steam, Gothic Lock Picking, Planet of Gothic
and Gothic.tools: selected factual observations and direct source references.
No blanket open license is asserted for those websites or their compiled databases.
The complete TH.GL, Wikily, Planet or Gothic.tools arrays are not redistributed.
An item absent from a partial list is not proven absent from the game chest.
Conflicting quantities/types are withheld. Game patch and local gameplay verification
are unknown unless separately stated. See docs/gothic-locks/LOOT-AUDIT.md.
